# The admin pair gives way to the team's want

With want-manager on, the replan drops every `admin-test` pair (card test: "an `admin-test` pair
left after `want-manager` is on fails a test"); the same hunt now arrives as a want, whose family
"RTX 3090" gives the narrow term "rtx 3090" plus the card's container terms "gaming pc" and "pc".
